name: John Tenniel’s illustrations
description: The 42 wood engravings from the first edition (1865), placed where Carroll’s text describes them.
credit: Illustrations by John Tenniel (1865), public domain. Images: Standard Ebooks, CC0.

illustrations.alt: The King and Queen of Hearts are seated side-by-side on thrones looking out at the court. The Knave of Hearts is in the foreground, arms crossed and nose in the air.
illustrations.caption: The King and Queen of Hearts were seated on their throne, with a great crowd assembled about them—all sorts of little birds and beasts, as well as the whole pack of cards.
illustrations.quote: with a great crowd assembled about them—all sorts of little birds and beasts
